title: Zara Larsson smashes New Zealand arena attendance record
summary: Zara Larsson broke New Zealand’s arena attendance record twice on her Midnight Sun Tour, unseating Linkin Park for the highest-attended show at Auckland’s Spark Arena, the country’s largest arena.
